task_definition.task_name: DAS Data Strain-to-Velocity Conversion via Time-Domain Slowness Detection

task_description.overview: Convert DAS strain data to particle velocity by detecting apparent slowness (reciprocal velocity) in the time domain using semblance maximization.
steps: Load the preprocessed DAS strain Section object from the pickle file.
For each time step on the target channel, perform slant stacking over a window length L to compute semblance across slowness values.
Select the slowness that maximizes semblance at each time step to obtain apparent velocity.
Multiply the strain rate by the detected velocity to convert to particle velocity.
Store the converted velocity trace in the Section object.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Using daspy package to load the DAS strain Section from {das_section_path}, and using `slant_stacking(L={window_length}, frqlow={frqlow}, frqhigh={frqhigh}, channel={show_channel})` to convert the strain to velocity for the specified channel. Then select the {show_channel} to compare the transformed velocity data with the original node seismometer data (loaded from {node_seismometer_path}), and enlarge the time range to show the P-wave and S-wave. Note: 1) consider using daspy package to load, process (e.g. slant_stacking, etc.). 2) Save the result into a pickle file {result_data} and the figure {result_figure}.
